hero.title: Accounting is what we do best.

overview.title: Services for individuals, businesses and the people who run them.
overview.text: Pick a service to see what it includes, or call and talk it through with our team.

services.title: Individual Tax Preparation
services.summary: Personal returns, filed accurately and on time.
services.text: We evaluate your individual tax situation and guide you through any tax challenges that develop, with the goal of minimizing your tax liability so you keep more of your hard-earned money.
services.lead: Filing a relatively simple return can be confusing, and it is just too easy to overlook deductions and credits you are entitled to. Even if you use a software program, there is no substitute for the assistance of an experienced tax professional.
services.imageAlt: A blank tax form, a calculator and a bundle of banknotes on a green desk

covers.title: Accurate returns, filed on time
covers.text: We prepare your return and file it on time, using our knowledge of current federal and state tax codes.

covers.title: Estimated taxes
covers.text: We calculate estimated taxes for self-employed small business owners.

covers.title: Planning strategies
covers.text: We develop tax planning strategies that reflect your individual financial goals.

covers.title: Electronic filing
covers.text: Electronic filing and direct deposit, for a faster tax refund.

covers.title: Extensions
covers.text: We file extensions and calculate estimated tax to avoid interest and penalties.

services.title: Tax Planning
services.summary: Year-round planning, not just at tax time.
services.text: There is more to preparing your taxes than filling out forms at tax time. We work with you all year long to develop strategies that lower your tax bill.
services.lead: Many people feel their tax bill is too high. Based on careful analysis of your tax situation, we make sure you take every tax credit and deduction you deserve.

covers.title: Credits and deductions
covers.text: Careful analysis of your situation, so you take every credit and deduction you deserve on your return.

covers.title: Recordkeeping
covers.text: We help you set up a recordkeeping system that meets IRS requirements.

covers.title: Withholding
covers.text: We review and adjust your paycheck withholding so it accurately reflects your tax situation.

covers.title: Deferring tax
covers.text: We help you understand how to defer tax liabilities through pension plans, retirement contributions and similar plans.

covers.title: Tax-exempt income
covers.text: We make sure you take advantage of certain investments that produce tax-exempt income, federal or state or both.

services.title: Estate and Trust Tax Services
services.summary: Trust and estate returns, and the plan behind them.
services.text: Estate and trust tax preparation and planning are an important part of managing your financial future, and not just for the one percent. It matters for everyone, especially if you have a spouse or children or own a business.
services.lead: As your trusted advisor, we help you develop an estate and trust plan that protects wealth and minimizes the tax burden on you and your loved ones. We work closely with investment advisors, attorneys and other financial professionals, and we stay current on the tax law changes that affect estate and trust tax preparation.

covers.title: Allocating assets
covers.text: Allocating assets to spouses, children, trusts and charities.

covers.title: Reviewing the plan
covers.text: Reviewing your estate plan and trust tax situation to make sure financial goals are met.

covers.title: Gift tax
covers.text: Gift tax returns and strategies.

covers.title: Business succession
covers.text: Business succession planning as part of the wider estate plan.

covers.title: Trust administration
covers.text: Trust administration, and trust income tax returns.

covers.title: Estate tax returns
covers.text: Estate tax returns prepared and filed.

services.title: Personal Financial Planning
services.summary: One-on-one guidance and a written plan.
services.text: You get one-on-one guidance and a comprehensive financial plan that helps manage risk, improve performance, and ensure the growth and longevity of your wealth.

services.title: Retirement Planning
services.summary: Plan ahead now, reap the benefits later.
services.text: Do not put retirement planning on the back burner. Use a tax professional to plan ahead now, and reap the benefits later.

services.title: Estate Planning
services.summary: Help through every step of the process.
services.text: The hassles and red tape associated with estate planning can be daunting, but you do not need to do it alone. Our team is waiting to assist you through every step of the process.

services.title: Tax Relief and IRS Problems
services.summary: Back taxes, audits, liens and levies.
services.text: We understand how the IRS works and what it takes to mediate a solution on your behalf, whether that is filing a past due return, minimizing back tax debt and penalties, or submitting an offer in compromise.
services.lead: If the IRS has caught up to you and is demanding payment, the worst thing you can do is keep ignoring it. We help you find a fair solution to your tax problem.

covers.title: IRS audit representation
covers.text: Rarely do our clients have to talk with the IRS. We handle the bureaucracy and the paperwork for you.

covers.title: Non-filed tax returns
covers.text: Getting delinquent returns filed before failing to file turns into something far more serious.

covers.title: Back taxes owed
covers.text: Penalties and interest add up fast. We offer several options for resolving unpaid taxes.

covers.title: Payroll tax problems
covers.text: The IRS treats unpaid payroll taxes as the cardinal sin of tax delinquency, because much of it is your employees' withholdings.

covers.title: Offer in compromise
covers.text: Settling your debt with the IRS through their Offer in Compromise program.

covers.title: IRS payment plan
covers.text: If you do not qualify for an offer in compromise, a payment plan may be the way to resolve the problem.

questions.q: What if I was not the one who caused the tax problem?
questions.a: Innocent Spouse Relief was designed to alleviate unjust situations where one spouse was clearly the victim of fraud perpetrated by their spouse or ex-spouse.

questions.q: What happens if I keep ignoring the notices?
questions.a: The next step is likely to be garnishing your wages, putting a lien on your home or a levy on your bank account. It will not go away unless you take action.

services.title: Small Business Accounting
services.summary: We keep the books so you can run the business.
services.text: As a small business owner, you have more important things to do than to keep your own books. We take care of your books for you, so you can get back to the job of running your business and generating profits.

services.title: Bookkeeping Services
services.summary: Payables, receivables, reconciliations, clean-up.
services.text: Accurate bookkeeping is essential to your company's long-term viability. Experienced, affordable and reliable, we serve a variety of industries and clients.
services.lead: We serve clients from self-employed home-based business owners to small and medium-sized businesses with employees. If you are just starting out, we set up reporting and recordkeeping systems that make it easy to track where your money is going. If you have been in business a while but need help cleaning up your books, we streamline your systems and set up checks and balances.
services.imageAlt: Blank printed forms and a pen on a wooden desk beside a small plant

services.title: Payroll
services.summary: Outsourced payroll with a dedicated specialist.
services.text: We offer payroll solutions that meet your business's needs and enable you to spend time doing what you do best, which is running your company.
services.lead: On average, small business owners spend eight hours per month on payroll-related tasks, and every year brings new federal, state or local legislation to comply with. When you outsource payroll to us you get a dedicated payroll specialist who works with you throughout the entire process.

services.lead: Now that you have employees, pay estimated taxes and need to manage cash flow, it is time to find a trusted advisor to partner with all year long, not just at tax time.

services.title: Cryptocurrency Accounting Services
services.summary: Digital currency, reported and compliant.
services.text: Whether you are a small business owner who accepts digital and virtual currency as payment or an individual investor, we handle the reporting and the compliance.
services.lead: The IRS defines virtual currency as a digital representation of value, so it is treated as property for tax purposes. Whether you experience a gain or a loss it has to be reported on Schedule D of IRS Form 1040, with long-term gains subject to capital gains rates and short-term gains taxed as ordinary income.

covers.title: Crypto tax returns
covers.text: Preparing cryptocurrency tax returns.

covers.title: Amended returns

covers.title: Accounting and reporting

services.title: Part-Time CFO Services
services.summary: A financial manager, without a full-time hire.
services.text: Our part-time CFO service gives you a professional financial manager who works with you to help guide your business to success.
services.lead: Businesses of all sizes benefit from a CFO or controller, but many small business owners worry they cannot afford one. Outsourced, part-time CFO services are a cost-effective solution.

covers.title: Payables and receivables

covers.title: Systems and controls

services.title: Financial Planning for Businesses
services.summary: Analysis and forecasting behind the decisions.
services.text: We advise company decision-makers on how to reach revenue and growth goals through strategic planning, by analyzing, synthesizing and translating your own data.
services.lead: If you have been in business a while, you could be coasting along, stuck in the routine of payroll, taxes and worrying about cash flow. Adding an accountant with expertise in financial planning and analysis to the team is what takes the business to another level.

covers.title: Reporting and analysis
covers.text: Financial reporting and analysis, and profitability analysis.

covers.title: Trends and variations
covers.text: Identifying company-wide trends and variations in your business financials.

covers.title: Forecasting

covers.title: Strategic plans

covers.title: Performance management

covers.title: Market analysis

services.title: Audits, Reviews and Compilations
services.summary: Three levels of assurance on your statements.
services.text: Your stockholders, creditors or private investors have different levels of risk tolerance, so we provide three levels of assurance to meet your needs.
services.lead: Which one is best for your business depends on the level of assurance or financial accuracy you want. You may decide a compilation is all you need this year, and that a review or an audit gives you better information in the years after.
services.imageAlt: Printed charts and graphs on a desk beside a calculator and a laptop

covers.title: Compilations
covers.text: The first level of service. There is no verification that the numbers are accurate, and the statements produced are for management and third-party use.

covers.title: Reviews
covers.text: More involved than a compilation, providing limited assurance. Key personnel are interviewed about accounting policies, procedures, industry, operations and statements, and a review report is issued.

covers.title: Audits
covers.text: The highest level of service. We work closely with key personnel to gain knowledge of internal control systems, and perform verification and substantiation procedures in accordance with Generally Accepted Auditing Standards.

services.title: QuickBooks Services
services.summary: Setup, training, review and tune-ups.
services.text: QuickBooks is easy to use and an affordable way to manage your business more efficiently. We are here for you at every step, from setup to periodic tune-ups.
services.lead: With both desktop and online versions, it is easy to view transaction records and prepare custom reports that help you manage cash flow, monitor income and expenses, and make sound business decisions.

covers.title: Setup and customization
covers.text: After we set up your QuickBooks software, we customize it for your business, including integrating third-party invoicing or bill pay software.

covers.title: Employee training
covers.text: Personalized training for you and your employees, at your location or ours.

covers.title: QuickBooks review
covers.text: Review, sort and process monthly or quarterly transactions, reconcile the general ledger and all accounts, and prepare required reports.

covers.title: Periodic tune-ups
covers.text: Periodic reviews of your QuickBooks system, cleaning up and organizing your bookkeeping.

services.title: New Business Formation
services.summary: Entity choice, systems and compliance from day one.
services.text: Opening your own business is exciting. It is everything that comes after the excitement has worn off that dictates whether a small business will make it or not.
services.lead: You would rather not deal with details like choosing a business entity, sales and payroll tax, or the accounting systems that help you manage cash flow. We are here to help you figure it out.

covers.title: Entity selection
covers.text: Determining which business entity best meets your goals and minimizes tax liability, including partnership agreements.

covers.title: Cash flow and planning
covers.text: Preparing a cash flow budget and a business plan to help you secure financing, if needed.

covers.title: Accounting systems
covers.text: Setting up an accounting system, billing systems and collections policies and procedures.

covers.title: Compliance
covers.text: Making sure you comply with state, local and federal tax law, including sales and use tax, payroll tax and a Federal EIN.

covers.title: Licences and permits
covers.text: Help filing the paperwork for state and local licences and permits as required.

services.title: Succession Planning
services.summary: Passing the business on, or preparing it for sale.
services.text: We work with business owners and their families to develop plans for transferring business ownership to the next generation or to new leadership.
services.lead: Eighty-five percent of family-owned firms have identified a family member as a successor, but just one in eight has a succession plan in place. If you decide to sell, we identify the financial strengths and weaknesses of your business and plan to maximize its value ahead of a sale. If you keep it in the family, we prepare your successor to take over.

covers.title: Internal transfer
covers.text: Assistance with the internal transfer of the business to a family member.

covers.title: Finding a buyer
covers.text: Identifying potential buyers, and business valuations in preparation for sale.

covers.title: Agreements
covers.text: Buy and sell agreements.

covers.title: Estate and gift tax
covers.text: Estate and trust tax planning, and gift tax planning.

covers.title: Retirement
covers.text: Retirement planning and tax projections for the owner.

covers.title: Restructuring
covers.text: Business restructuring ahead of the handover.

services.title: Cash Flow Management
services.summary: A cash flow projection before a crisis hits.
services.text: A cash crisis can be emotionally devastating, and it can even kill your business. The starting point for avoiding one is allowing us to develop a cash flow projection for you.

services.title: Bank Financing
services.summary: Going to the lender prepared and organized.
services.text: Requesting a business loan without adequate preparation sends a clear message to the lender: high risk. It pays to be prepared and organized in your approach for financing.

services.title: Non-Profit Organizations
services.summary: Keeping your tax-exempt status intact.
services.text: The IRS uses very specific revenue and expense classifications to determine if your organization will retain its tax-exempt status.

services.title: Internal Controls
services.summary: Assessing the checks and balances you rely on.
services.text: We assess your internal control systems to determine the efficiency and effectiveness of your operating procedures, then we make recommendations that help your company become stronger.

about.title: A Galveston firm built on professionalism, responsiveness and quality.
text: Katherine Overbeck Maxwell CPA PLLC is a full service tax, accounting and business consulting firm located in Galveston, TX. We offer a broad range of services for business owners, executives and independent professionals.

Our firm is responsive. Companies who choose our firm rely on competent advice and fast, accurate personnel. We provide total financial services to individuals, large and small businesses and other agencies. Because we get new business from the people who know us best, client referrals have fuelled our growth in recent years.

Our primary goal as a trusted advisor is to be available and to provide insightful advice that enables our clients to make informed financial decisions. We feel it is extremely important to continually educate ourselves professionally, to improve our technical expertise, financial knowledge and service to our clients.

team.name: Katherine Maxwell, CPA
team.bio: Katherine graduated magna cum laude from Texas A&M University with a BBA in Accounting. She began her career working in the nonprofit arena then later transitioned to public accounting. She has more than twenty years experience in tax, accounting and auditing. Katherine is a member of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants and the Texas Society of Certified Public Accountants.

team.name: Alpha Jallow, CPA
team.bio: Alpha graduated magna cum laude from the University of Houston Clear Lake with a Bachelor of Science in Accounting. He has extensive experience in performing Single Audits on both governmental and not for profit entities.

team.name: Bobbie Weatherton
team.bio: Bobbie is the office secretary and payroll clerk. She has more than twenty years of experience preparing payrolls for a variety of industries.
